abilities.name: Dragon Spirit
abilities.text: If Rayquaza C is your Active Pokémon and is damaged but not Knocked Out by an opponent's attack, you may search your discard pile for an Energy card and attach it to Rayquaza C.

attacks.name: Final Blowup
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Rayquaza C. Ignore this effect if you have no cards in your hand.

rules: Put this card onto your Active Rayquaza C. Rayquaza C LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

grading_target.suggested_submission_description_not_off: 2009 POKEMON SUPREME VICTORS RAYQUAZA C LV.X #146
inspection_priorities: Holo scratches across the border and artwork

collector_assessment.why_it_is_collectible: A Pokémon SP and LV.X-era Rayquaza with a distinctive sideways level-up layout and 200-damage attack.
authentication_risks_and_checks: Compare the card against a known-authentic example: font, symbols, borders, colors, and card stock.
Inspect holofoil or texture under moving light; flat, printed-on shine is a major warning sign.
For a graded card, verify the certification number directly with the grading company and compare the slab image.
Check for trimming, rebacking, recoloring, pressed dents, filled whitening, or other restoration.
For high-value purchases, use an established seller, protected payment method, return rights, and third-party authentication.
storage_recommendations: Do not handle the card surface with bare fingers.
For raw cards: use a clean inner sleeve, rigid holder, and archival storage box.
For graded cards: use a slab sleeve and a fitted protective case.
Store upright in a stable, dry environment away from direct sunlight and rapid temperature changes.
Do not expose the card to cleaners, adhesive labels, PVC pages, or pressure from overfilled binders.

market_research.note: Use recent completed sales for the same language, exact card number, grading company, numeric grade, qualifier, and certification status. Asking prices are not equivalent to realized prices.
